title: Buffalo: Wings, Strangers, and a Closed Door
titleZh: 布法罗：鸡翅、陌生人与闭门羹
description: Steven records outside a Buffalo tavern and recounts a night in a traveling salesman's hotel room, a free manuscript museum, Buffalo wings at Gabriel's Gate, and being turned away from a charity house. He weighs pricey options for leaving town and asks whether anyone can really travel the U.S. this way, and he also meets a bartender who is learning Chinese.

sentences.zh: 快速回顾
sentences.en: Quick recap

sentences.zh: 史蒂文今天在纽约州布法罗的乌尔里希酒馆门外录音，中途还被两辆刹车刺耳的公交车打断。
sentences.en: Today Steven is recording outside Ulrich's Tavern in Buffalo, New York, and he gets interrupted by two buses with screeching brakes.

sentences.zh: 他还在找便宜的住处，也还在问自己为什么要来这趟旅行。
sentences.en: He's still looking for a cheap place to stay, and still asking himself why he came on this trip.

sentences.zh: 今天，他在陌生人的酒店房间过了一夜，逛了免费的手稿博物馆，吃了布法罗鸡翅，被一家慈善旅舍拒之门外，还认识了一位学中文的酒保。
sentences.en: Today he spent the night in a stranger's hotel room, visited a free manuscript museum, ate Buffalo wings, was turned away by a charity hostel, and met a bartender who is learning Chinese.

sentences.zh: 你还爱美国吗？
sentences.en: Do you still love America?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文替听众问了一句：“你还爱美国吗？”
sentences.en: Steven asked on behalf of the listeners: "Do you still love America?"

sentences.zh: 他说，这就像大家以为他在中国住了12年，就一定爱中国，其实中国“只是给我的工资很高”。
sentences.en: He said it's like how people assume that because he lived in China for 12 years, he must love China, when really China "just pays me a high salary."

sentences.zh: 他更关心的是：在美国或加拿大，他能不能过上同样好的生活？
sentences.en: What he cares about more is whether he can have an equally good life in the US or Canada.

sentences.zh: 在布法罗找便宜住处太难，“动不动就90、100美元”。
sentences.en: Finding cheap accommodation in Buffalo is really hard: "it's easily 90 or 100 dollars."

sentences.zh: 不过他也承认，少下馆子、多啃苹果，就能省出住酒店的钱。
sentences.en: But he also admits that by eating out less and munching on more apples, he can save enough for a hotel.

sentences.zh: 免费博物馆，和靠媒体赚钱的政客
sentences.en: A free museum, and politicians who make money from the media

sentences.zh: 去租车行的路上，史蒂文走进了卡佩莱斯手稿图书馆博物馆。
sentences.en: On the way to the car rental place, Steven walked into the Karpeles Manuscript Library Museum.

sentences.zh: 偌大的老楼像剧院，又像教堂，设计讲究，里面却破败不堪，只有一位工作人员。
sentences.en: The huge old building looks like a theater, and also like a church; it's elaborately designed, but inside it's badly run-down, with only one staff member.

sentences.zh: 藏品是一位富有的地产商收集的，包括：
sentences.en: The collection was assembled by a wealthy real estate developer, and includes:

sentences.zh: 和早期航天有关的苏联文件
sentences.en: Soviet documents related to early spaceflight

sentences.zh: 一两百年前的直升机草图
sentences.en: Helicopter sketches from one or two hundred years ago

sentences.zh: 比莱特兄弟更早的航空先驱手稿
sentences.en: Manuscripts by aviation pioneers who came before the Wright brothers

sentences.zh: 博物馆免费参观。
sentences.en: Admission to the museum is free.

sentences.zh: 据说楼里闹鬼，可惜史蒂文没拍到。
sentences.en: The building is said to be haunted, but unfortunately Steven didn't capture anything on camera.

sentences.zh: 工作人员说，媒体只盯着声音最大的极端派，温和的大多数却无人问津。
sentences.en: The staff member said the media only focuses on the loudest extremists, while the moderate majority gets ignored.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文也有个“纯属猜测”的想法：特朗普等政客可能靠出格的帖子赚钱，广告收入通过超级政治行动委员会流回他们手里。
sentences.en: Steven also has a "pure speculation" idea: politicians like Trump may make money from outrageous posts, with the ad revenue flowing back to them through super PACs.

sentences.zh: 与旅行推销员共度一夜
sentences.en: A Night with a Traveling Salesman

sentences.zh: 昨天的悬念是：史蒂文会不会被绑架？
sentences.en: Yesterday's cliffhanger: would Steven get kidnapped?

sentences.zh: 原来，酒吧里那位男士是科技初创公司的推销员，公司的软件能帮律所写出毫无歧义的信。
sentences.en: As it turned out, the man at the bar was a salesman for a tech startup whose software helps law firms write completely unambiguous letters.

sentences.zh: 他分给史蒂文半个披萨，还让他睡凯悦酒店房间里的另一张床。
sentences.en: He gave Steven half a pizza and even let him sleep in the other bed in his Hyatt hotel room.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文起初半信半疑，酒保也说她绝不会跟陌生人回家。
sentences.en: Steven was skeptical at first, and the bartender also said she would never go home with a stranger.

sentences.zh: 推销员解释说，上周在纽约有陌生人收留过他，他这是在报恩。
sentences.en: The salesman explained that a stranger had taken him in last week in New York, and he was paying the kindness forward.

sentences.zh: 结果史蒂文一夜好眠：“肾还在。”
sentences.en: In the end, Steven had a good night's sleep: "Kidneys still intact."

sentences.zh: 用他的话说，推销员“救我于一场非自愿的器官捐献”。
sentences.en: In his words, the salesman "saved me from an involuntary organ donation."

sentences.zh: 布法罗历史、昆达里尼瑜伽和4x4x48
sentences.en: Buffalo history, Kundalini yoga, and the 4x4x48

sentences.zh: 推销员白天听ChatGPT讲了一整天布法罗历史：
sentences.en: During the day, the salesman listened to ChatGPT talk about Buffalo history all day long:

sentences.zh: 伊利运河让布法罗成了航运要道，从蒙特利尔抢走了不少贸易。
sentences.en: The Erie Canal made Buffalo a major shipping route, taking a lot of trade away from Montreal.

sentences.zh: 后来圣劳伦斯河船闸开通，两座城市都受到打击。
sentences.en: Later, when the St. Lawrence River locks opened, both cities took a hit.

sentences.zh: 布法罗曾是美国十大城市之一。
sentences.en: Buffalo was once one of the ten largest cities in the US.

sentences.zh: 喝着威士忌，推销员演示了昆达里尼瑜伽：动作轻柔重复，疼了也要坚持。
sentences.en: Over whiskey, the salesman demonstrated Kundalini yoga: gentle, repetitive movements that you keep doing even when it hurts.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文则介绍了4x4x48挑战：48小时内，每4小时跑4英里。
sentences.en: Steven, in turn, explained the 4x4x48 challenge: run 4 miles every 4 hours for 48 hours.

sentences.zh: 他明年3月可能再挑战一次。
sentences.en: He might take it on again next March.

sentences.zh: “它本来就不是为了好玩。”
sentences.en: "It was never meant to be fun."

sentences.zh: 加布里埃尔之门的布法罗鸡翅
sentences.en: Buffalo Wings at Gabriel's Gate

sentences.zh: 本地夫妇推荐他去加布里埃尔之门。
sentences.en: A local couple recommended that he go to Gabriel's Gate.

sentences.zh: 据说鸡翅起源于安克酒吧：一位母亲把鸡翅边角料炸了，给饥肠辘辘的年轻人吃。
sentences.en: Wings are said to have originated at the Anchor Bar: a mother fried up leftover wing scraps to feed some hungry young people.

sentences.zh: 传统配的是蓝纹奶酪酱。
sentences.en: Traditionally they come with blue cheese dressing.

sentences.zh: 10个鸡翅： 21美元，个大肉多，“不坑人”，辣得舒服，就是太咸太油。
sentences.en: 10 wings: $21. They're big and meaty, "not a rip-off," pleasantly spicy, just too salty and greasy.

sentences.zh: 牛排三明治： 约18到19美元。
sentences.en: Steak sandwich: about $18 to $19.

sentences.zh: 薯片被他退了：“炸的东西太多了。”
sentences.en: He sent back the chips: "Too much fried stuff."

sentences.zh: 合计： 含小费46美元，全天花了53美元，晚饭吃剩菜。
sentences.en: Total: $46 including tip, $53 spent for the whole day, with leftovers for dinner.

sentences.zh: 他胖了吗？
sentences.en: Did he gain weight?

sentences.zh: 他希望自己不浮肿，“可浮肿的人不都这么说吗？”
sentences.en: He hopes he's not bloated, "but isn't that what all bloated people say?"

sentences.zh: 在凯文之家吃了闭门羹
sentences.en: Turned away at Kevin's House

sentences.zh: 在一家戒瘾互助中心，工作人员好心要给他提供饭菜和淋浴，大概是他的行李和19英寸长的大胡子让人误会了。
sentences.en: At an addiction recovery support center, the staff kindly offered him a meal and a shower. His luggage and his 19-inch beard probably gave them the wrong idea.

sentences.zh: 网上评论说，凯文之家只要你捐款就来者不拒。
sentences.en: Online reviews said Kevin's House turns no one away as long as you make a donation.

sentences.zh: 可史蒂文“太老实了”，不肯编一个住院的亲戚。
sentences.en: But Steven was "too honest" and wouldn't make up a relative in the hospital.

sentences.zh: 睡地板、捐款、做义工，全被拒绝。
sentences.en: Sleeping on the floor, donating, volunteering: he was turned down for all of it.

sentences.zh: 经理建议他去“城市使命”救助所。
sentences.en: The manager suggested he go to the "City Mission" shelter.

sentences.zh: 他边喝6美元的啤酒边琢磨：“住进‘城市使命’，那你的使命是什么？”
sentences.en: Over a 6-dollar beer, he mused: "If you move into the 'City Mission,' then what's your mission?"

sentences.zh: 我还有哪些选择？
sentences.en: What other options do I have?

sentences.zh: 租车行已经关门。
sentences.en: The car rental place has already closed.

sentences.zh: 今晚他可以选：
sentences.en: Tonight he can choose from:

sentences.zh: 23:05去克利夫兰的灰狗巴士： 票价涨到113美元，凌晨两三点到。
sentences.en: The 23:05 Greyhound bus to Cleveland: the fare has gone up to $113, arriving at two or three in the morning.

sentences.zh: 0:40的火车： 可去车站的末班公交9:30左右就没了。
sentences.en: The 0:40 train: but the last bus to the station stops running around 9:30.

sentences.zh: 租车： 约120美元，还要冻结押金。
sentences.en: Renting a car: about $120, plus a hold placed on a deposit.

sentences.zh: 90美元的酒店、2美元就能到的机场，或去底特律的夜班车。
sentences.en: A $90 hotel, an airport you can reach for $2, or the night bus to Detroit.

sentences.zh: 真正的问题是：谁能真的这样游美国？
sentences.en: The real question is: who can actually travel around America like this?

sentences.zh: 劳动节只能解释一部分高价。
sentences.en: Labor Day only explains part of the high prices.

sentences.zh: 学中文的酒保
sentences.en: The Bartender Learning Chinese

sentences.zh: 昨晚那位酒保刚在大学开始学汉语，会说“你好”，还不会写。
sentences.en: The bartender from last night has just started studying Chinese at university. She can say "nǐ hǎo" but can't write yet.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说，他认识的中文流利的美国人，都是去中国前就开始学，到了也一直坚持。
sentences.en: Steven said the Americans he knows who speak fluent Chinese all started learning before going to China and kept at it after they arrived.

sentences.zh: 她打算明年夏天去中国学习。
sentences.en: She plans to go study in China next summer.

sentences.zh: 他们的对话几周后会在“史蒂文的语言博客”上线。
sentences.en: Their conversation will go up on "Steven's Language Blog" in a few weeks.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 今晚是乌尔里希酒馆的“护士之夜”。
sentences.en: Tonight is "Nurses' Night" at Ulrich's Tavern.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文还在布法罗、克利夫兰和底特律之间犹豫，再过几天就要回加拿大和中国了。
sentences.en: Steven is still torn between Buffalo, Cleveland, and Detroit, and in a few days he'll be heading back to Canada and China.

sentences.zh: 他的结论是：“也许，这就是美国的现状。”
sentences.en: His conclusion: "Maybe this is just the way America is now."

vocab.en: to turn someone away at the door
